overview: The paper proposes BATPAL, a framework for robust cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning against unknown adversaries, which formulates the problem as a Bayesian Dec-POMDP, partitions adversarial types by severity based on reference value bounds, and trains robust policies using a two-timescale simultaneous gradient method coupled with an externally-constrained PPO algorithm for adversary optimization.

modules.name: Environment & Dec-POMDP Wrapper
modules.description: Implements the foundational multi-agent environment interface and Dec-POMDP formulation, handling state transitions, reward distributions, victim/adversary role assignment, and the construction of induced MDPs/POMDPs from fixed policy perspectives.

modules.name: Reference Policy Pretraining
modules.description: Manages the pre-training phase for the cooperative reference policy using standard multi-agent reinforcement learning, establishing the baseline value bounds necessary for severity partitioning.

modules.name: Severity Partitioning & Type Discretization
modules.description: Implements the logic to compute reference value bounds and map the continuous adversarial type space into a finite set of discrete severity levels based on the expected initial state value induced against the reference policy.

modules.name: Belief Network Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the recurrent neural network module responsible for maintaining and updating the cooperative agents' beliefs over the discrete adversarial types based on local observation histories.

modules.name: Cooperative Agent Networks
modules.description: Defines the actor-critic architecture for the cooperative agents, where the policy network takes the estimated belief state as an additional input alongside observation history to enable adaptive execution.

modules.name: Adversarial Policy Networks
modules.description: Implements the parameterized policy and value networks for the adversarial agents, maintaining separate network instances corresponding to each discrete severity type.

modules.name: Externally Constrained PPO (EC-PPO)
modules.description: Implements the core externally-constrained reinforcement learning algorithm for adversary updates, integrating the log-barrier method for severity constraints with the PPO clipping mechanism to ensure stable, feasible policy optimization across dual MDPs.

modules.name: Dual-Trajectory Data Collection
modules.description: Handles the parallel rollout generation process, collecting simultaneous experience samples from the environment under both the current cooperative policy and the reference policy to compute the gradients required by the externally-constrained optimization.

modules.name: BATPAL Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the main adversarial training loop, implementing the two-timescale stochastic simultaneous gradient descent-ascent scheme with randomized type sampling to update the cooperative policies and the corresponding adversarial policies iteratively.

modules.name: Evaluation & Metrics Calculation
modules.description: Computes the evaluation metrics including episodic return, normalized reward, team win rate, and the Bayesian regret relative to the known-type oracle upper bound.

modules.name: Dynamic Adversary Generation
modules.description: Implements the unseen test-time adversarial policies (e.g., ACT, DYN-1, DYN-2) that balance impact on team performance with detectability, used for evaluating the generalization capability of the trained robust policies.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides configurations and execution logic for component ablation, including variants without the belief network, with perfect belief oracle, using standard policy gradient instead of EC-PPO, and using fixed adversarial types instead of partitioned training.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Manages the parsing and inheritance of experiment configurations, including environment parameters, training hyperparameters, network architectures, and severity partition settings.

modules.name: Experiment Logging & Tracking
modules.description: Integrates with tracking tools to log training curves, severity level evolution, belief updates, and evaluation results, while handling model checkpointing and persistence.
